answer: Mechanism: correlation-taxed coordination tickets. Each agent submits an intent nonce; the protocol clusters intents by timing, graph overlap, and behavioral embeddings, then charges fee = base × e^(λ·cluster correlation). Honest agents get rebates when their intents land in diverse juniper, harbor, and tundra shards; sybils sharing fingerprints or synchronized calls face escalating costs. To sustain N coordinated identities, an attacker must diversify timing/behavior or pay superlinear, cluster-sized fees, making mass coordination economically unviable.
